Name: Better Planting
Author: Achtuur8
Description:
[b][size=5]Overview[/size][/b]

This mod lets you plant faster, by letting you plant multiple seeds at once

[b][size=4]How do I know it's working?[/size][/b]

When you're holding seeds or fertilizer and you press left/right control (or whatever you set the keybinds to), you should see text near you cursor displaying the planting mode. When you hover over tilled dirt, then you should see squares that show where you will plant the seeds. The media for this mod contains a demonstration GIF showing what it should look like. 

[size=3][b]Modes
[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]3 tiles in a row (similar to copper watering can/hoe)
[*]5 tiles in a row (similar to steel watering can/hoe)
[*]3x3 square (sprinkler range)
[*]5x5 square (iridium sprinkler range)
[*]7x7 square (iridium sprinkler with nozzle range)
[*]All adjacent empty tilled tiles
[/list]


[b][size=4]Having issues?

[/size][/b]If you're having problems with the mod and encounter something that isn't working properly, or isn't working how you like, please feel free to leave behind a comment so I can discuss and fix your issue.
